newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Clark says more meetings possible with Peters.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Clark says more meetings possible with Peters.

text.p: New Zealand Labour leader Helen Clark said on Monday that further meetings with New Zealand First were possible as politicians engaged in a frantic late burst of coalition talks.

"We will keep meeting as necessary. We are not ruling out future meetings. We are making progress towards New Zealand First finalising its position tomorrow," Clark said after meeting NZ First leader Winston Peters.
Labour was due to hold more talks later on Monday with the left-wing Alliance.
NZ First holds the balance of power between the Labour and conservative National parties and its MPs are due to choose their preferred coalition partner on Tuesday.
